title: A Snowy Day
description: Three short recordings about a snowy day: a morning at home, a weather report and a game outside.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Snow at home
parts.intro: You will hear Ben and his mum on a winter morning.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Ben, wake up! Look out of the window. It snowed all night!

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Wow! Is school open today, Mum?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: No, the school is closed. The radio says the roads are icy.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Yes! Can I go out and play with my cousin Tom?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: After breakfast. And you must wear your hat, scarf and gloves. It's very cold. Don't stay out too long, and come in for hot soup at lunchtime.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Can I wear my red boots?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: No, they're wet. Wear your green ones, by the door.

parts.title: Part 2 · The weather report
parts.intro: You will hear a radio weather and travel report.

script.speaker: Mr Grant
script.text: Good morning. This is your weather and travel report for today.

script.speaker: Mr Grant
script.text: Snow fell overnight, and there are about twenty centimetres in the north of town. More snow is coming this afternoon.

script.speaker: Mr Grant
script.text: Buses are running, but they are slow. The train to the city is cancelled, and the airport is closed until tomorrow. Please check the bus times on the internet before you leave home.

script.speaker: Mr Grant
script.text: If you drive, go slowly. And remember, the lake in the park is not safe for walking or skating.

script.speaker: Mr Grant
script.text: Tomorrow will be sunny, so the snow will start to melt.

parts.title: Part 3 · Building a snowman
parts.intro: You will hear Ben and his friend Linh outside in the snow.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Ben, let's build a snowman! I've got a carrot for his nose.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Great idea. I'll make the body, and you make the head.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: We need two black stones for his eyes. And your scarf. Is that OK?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Hmm, it's my favourite scarf, but OK. He looks cold.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Now he's finished. Let's call him Mr Frosty.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Perfect. Now can we go down the hill on my sledge? I'm so happy about the snow today. Maybe tomorrow we can make a snow family, with a mum, a dad and a baby.
